categories.main_business_segments: Beijing FJR Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of infrared thermal imaging products and systems. Its main product categories include cores (modules), thermal imagers, and optoelectronic systems. The company also develops multispectral sensing technologies including solid-state low-light, shortwave, laser, and visible light products, serving both military and civilian markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in non-cooled infrared detectors, MEMS wafer design and manufacturing, packaging, detector drive control, thermal imaging image processing, multispectral fusion, and special optical system design. It has capabilities in CMOS readout circuit chip design, MEMS infrared sensor chip production, packaging, testing, and assembly of infrared thermal imaging cores and systems. Production involves a combination of in-house manufacturing and outsourced wafer fabrication, with a focus on customized, order-driven production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military general units and civilian system integrators. Military applications cover general armaments, individual soldier equipment, ground, air, and naval platforms. Civilian markets include industrial temperature measurement, gas detection, petrochemical, power inspection, firefighting, and emergency response. The company maintains stable relationships with major customers, including China Ordnance Industry Group and China Electronics Technology Group.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Beijing and subsidiaries in Henan (Luoyang), Shaanxi (Xi'an), and other regions. Domestic sales dominate, with minor export sales. The company is focused on expanding its presence in both domestic military and civilian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: FJR operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacture of core components such as infrared detector chips, modules, and integrated systems. It supplies these components to upstream wafer foundries and downstream system integrators and military general units. The company is progressively increasing its self-supply of key components to enhance competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment in infrared thermal imaging and multispectral sensing technologies, including non-cooled infrared detectors, image processing algorithms, optical system design, and laser sensing products. It aims to enhance product performance, reduce size and power consumption, and expand product lines into solid-state low-light, shortwave, laser, and visible light domains. Collaborations with research institutes and talent development are key to sustaining innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized infrared thermal imaging cores, thermal imagers, and optoelectronic systems to military and civilian customers. The company follows an order-driven production model with some inventory production. It also earns income from technology transfer and related services. Government subsidies and grants contribute to other income but are not the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FJR is positioned as a leading domestic infrared thermal imaging technology company with advanced R&D and manufacturing capabilities. It competes with international firms primarily in the military infrared imaging market, where foreign companies dominate. Domestically, it is a key supplier to military general units and is expanding its civilian market share. The company emphasizes indigenous innovation and product differentiation to compete against both domestic and foreign competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 302.27 million, a 44.4% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.64 million. Total assets reached RMB 736.39 million, up 9.95%. The company has shown a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding civilian business and improved product competitiveness. R&D expenses accounted for 16.74% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FJR offers highly customized, high-performance infrared thermal imaging products with advanced core technologies such as non-cooled infrared detectors, multispectral fusion, and proprietary image processing algorithms. Its products provide superior image quality, sensitivity, and operational reliability in harsh environments. The company’s integrated design and manufacturing capabilities enable rapid product iteration and tailored solutions, enhancing customer value in both military and civilian applications. Indigenous technology development reduces reliance on imports, improving cost competitiveness and supply security.
